basics.name: Oluwadamilola (Dammy) Owolabi
basics.label: Electrical Engineer | Data Scientist
basics.summary: Electrical engineer with an MS in Data Science who designs medium- and low-voltage distribution systems for major utilities. I combine power systems fundamentals (load calculations, short circuit analysis, underground duct bank design) with Python, SQL, R, and BI tools to turn engineering and operational data into decisions. Open to electrical engineering, data science, and analytics roles.

work.name: Leidos
work.summary: Medium- and low-voltage distribution design for major investor-owned utility clients.
highlights: Performed load calculations, short circuit analysis, and conduit sizing and fill checks for MV/LV distribution designs.
Sized transformers, step banks, conductors, fuses, and poles, drafted design schematics, and engineered underground duct bank layouts.
Built material lists for designs and SAP work orders and ran estimate-versus-actual cost and material variance checks to find root causes.
Performed QA/QC on design packages, mentored newer designers, built a reusable team design template, and tracked work in Jira dashboards.

work.name: Ferreira Co.

Designed electrical service for residential solar and battery storage customers.
Cut material costs by about 10% per project, a few hundred dollars each, by removing unnecessary materials and labor from estimates.
Created SAP work orders and notifications, built material lists, and ran estimate-versus-actual variance checks.
